title: Go: CRDT Counter
description: Build CRDT counters (G-Counter, PN-Counter, OR-Set) with per-replica state and merge semantics.

steps.title: G-Counter: increment and value
steps.description: Define `GCounter` with `state map[string]int` (replica ID → count). Implement `Increment(replicaID string)` (adds 1) and `Value() int` (sums all counts). Print the value after incrementing with two different replica IDs.
hints: `Value()` loops over map values and sums them.
Initialize the map in a `NewGCounter() *GCounter` constructor.

verification.successMessage: G-Counter value sums all replica increments.
verification.failureMessage: Increment on two replicas should give Value() == 2.

steps.title: G-Counter: merge with max
steps.description: Implement `Merge(other GCounter)` that takes the element-wise `max` of state maps (per-replica). Print the value before and after merging two G-Counters with different replica histories.
hints: For each key in both counters, keep `max(c1.state[k], c2.state[k])`.
Use a new map and iterate over both, taking the max.

verification.failureMessage: Merge should take the max for each replica's count.

steps.title: PN-Counter: positive and negative
steps.description: Implement `PNCounter` with `pos *GCounter` and `neg *GCounter`. `Increment(replicaID)` calls `pos.Increment(replicaID)`. `Decrement(replicaID)` calls `neg.Increment(replicaID)`. `Value() int` returns `pos.Value() - neg.Value()`. Print the value after incrementing and decrementing.
hints: PNCounter embeds or holds two GCounters.
`Value()` subtracts neg total from pos total.

verification.failureMessage: Value() should be pos total minus neg total.

steps.title: PN-Counter: state merge
steps.description: Implement `PNCounter.Merge(other PNCounter)` by merging both `pos` and `neg` sub-counters. Print the value after merging two PN-Counters and verify it equals the expected sum of individual operations.
hints: Merge pos with pos, neg with neg using GCounter.Merge.
CRDT merge is idempotent, commutative, and associative.
Print the value after merge to confirm correctness.

verification.successMessage: PN-Counter merge combines pos and neg correctly.
verification.failureMessage: Both positive and negative GCounters must be merged separately.

steps.title: OR-Set implementation
steps.description: Implement an Observed-Remove Set (`ORSet`) with `state map[string]map[string]struct{}` (element → set of replica+timestamp tags). `Add(elem string, replicaID string)` adds a tag; `Remove(elem string)` adds all current tags to a tombstone; `Contains(elem string) bool` checks if any active tags remain. Print the result of add, remove, and contains operations.
hints: Each element has a set of unique tags (replicaID + counter).
On Remove, move all tags for the element to a separate tombstone set.
Contains returns true if element has any tags not in the tombstone.

verification.successMessage: OR-Set correctly tracks adds and removes.
verification.failureMessage: After add, Contains should be true; after remove, false.

steps.title: Replication simulator
steps.description: Build a `Replica` struct with an ID and a CRDT (e.g. GCounter). Simulate three replicas: each increments, then they exchange state via `Merge`. Print the final converged value across all replicas using `fmt.Println(replica.Value())` for each.
hints: Create a slice of replicas, each with their own GCounter.
Simulate a gossip protocol: each replica merges with a random peer.
After enough merges, all replicas should converge to the same value.

verification.successMessage: All replicas converge to the same value after gossip.
verification.failureMessage: After merging, all replicas should have identical values.
